typography.rules: Headings must be bold and commanding. Use JetBrains Mono for all data points (IDs, Container Numbers, Dates).

layout_strategy.dashboard: Bento Grid: Mixed span cards. Key stats = 1x1. Activity Feed = 1x2 (tall). Maps/Charts = 2x2 or full width.
layout_strategy.forms: Split Layout or Single Column with generous whitespace. Group related fields with visible borders or varied background shades.
layout_strategy.tables: Dense, highly readable. Sticky headers. Alternating row colors optional but borders are mandatory.
layout_strategy.sidebar: Fixed width (64 or 250px). Collapsible. Dark mode heavily preferred for sidebar to anchor the design.

buttons.primary: bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white rounded-md font-bold shadow-sm transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-md font-medium shadow-sm

cards.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm rounded-lg overflow-hidden

inputs.style: border-slate-300 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500 rounded-md bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm placeholder:text-slate-400

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-md for dropdowns/modals. Avoid large diffuse shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid slate-200 default. Active elements get 1px solid red-600.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px). Avoid full rounded/pill shapes for containers.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React. Use stroke-width-2 for clarity.

instructions_to_main_agent: REFACTOR: Update tailwind.config.js to use Red-600 as the primary color. Remove the Teal.
LAYOUT: Sidebar must be Dark Slate (bg-slate-900) with White text. Active link = Red-600 background.
LOGIN: Use the 'login_bg' image for the left side of the split screen. Right side white.
DASHBOARD: Create a summary grid at the top. Use 'driver_red_truck' or 'ship_sunset' as cover images for specific widget cards.
FORMS: Ensure all inputs have red focus rings (focus:ring-red-500).
TABLES: Use a clean, dense layout. Header row: bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-bold.
GLOBAL: Add a subtle top border (h-1 bg-red-600) to the body or main layout to brand the app immediately.
CRITICAL: Do not break existing functionality. Only update styles and layout structure.
universal_guidelines: Avoid gradients for backgrounds, use solid colors or subtle noise.
Use uppercase, tracking-wide text for small labels (STATUS, ID, TYPE).
Ensure high contrast: Black text on White, White text on Red/Dark Slate.
